g.data-timing: 2 x SYNC (BITS/J.211/DTI) RJ-45, IEEE 1588 RJ-45, 2 x inter-chassis sync RJ-45, 10 MHz and 1 PPS SMB
g.title: a9k-rsp440-tr

rect.data-description: the four-character 5x7 LED dot-matrix display. What it shows is a message vocabulary - the guide gives it two sections, boot-stage/runtime and CAN bus controller errors - not a lamp state list, so it is a display and not an indicator.

circle.data-description: Power Fail (FAIL). Red: standby power fail; the LED is turned off by the CAN bus controller once it is up and running. Off: standby power is normal.
Alarm Cutoff (ACO). Amber: alarm cutoff has been enabled - the ACO push button was pressed after at least one alarm occurred.
Synchronization (SYNC). Green: system timing is synchronized to an external source. Amber: system timing is free running. Off: no system timing is configured.
Critical Alarm (CRIT). Red: a critical alarm has occurred.
Major Alarm (MAJ). Red: a major alarm has occurred.
Minor Alarm (MIN). Amber: a minor alarm has occurred.
the LAMP TEST momentary push button.
